title: NCAA: San Beda holds off Mapua for third straight win
summary: The San Beda Red Lions showed their poise in holding on for a 61-57 win against the Mapua Cardinals in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament, Thursday at the San Juan Arena.
